name: Well-formed METS
description: Every METS.xml of the package is well-formed XML without a DOCTYPE.

name: Schema-valid METS
description: Every METS.xml of the package is valid against METS 1.12 and the DILCIS extension schemas.

name: Checksum can be verified
description: The algorithm in @CHECKSUMTYPE is one this validator can compute (all METS values except HAVAL and MNP), so that the checksum can be verified.

name: Other metadata files intact
description: Technical and source metadata files exist and match the size and checksum recorded in METS. CSIP numbers these checks only for descriptive, provenance and rights metadata and for files.

name: Every file is referenced
description: Every file in the package is referenced from a METS document of the package, apart from the package METS.xml itself.

name: Representation METS readable
description: A representation METS document the package METS points to can be read.
